title: Project Manager
company: Alteora : Business Consulting | HR Consulting | IT Recruitments
description:
TSK INDIA BUILDCON

General Manager / Project Manager

**Real Estate Construction and Development**

**Location:**
 Multiple project sites across Meerut and Western Uttar Pradesh

**Employment:**
 Full-time, on-site; regular travel between assigned sites

**Qualification:**
 B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering mandatory.

**Experience:**
 Minimum 10 years specifically in project management and construction leadership roles in real estate construction and development.

**Joining:**
 Immediate preferred; maximum notice period 15-20 days.

Role purpose

Take ownership of assigned real estate projects from mobilisation through civil execution, MEP integration, interiors, finishes, commissioning and final handover. Deliver agreed milestones within approved budgets and quality standards, lead junior technical teams, and manage contractors across Western Uttar Pradesh. Resolve routine execution issues independently within delegated authority and escalate decisions with clear options and recovery plans.

Project scope

Residential townships, plotted colonies, villas and commercial or high-rise developments, according to project allocation. Works include roads, sewers, storm-water drainage, water supply, underground electrical utilities, boundary walls, landscaping, foundations, RCC structures, building services, interiors and external development.

Mandatory candidate requirements

• B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering. Diploma-only candidates will not be considered.

• At least 10 years spent specifically in accountable Project Management or construction leadership positions. General civil experience or junior site-engineering tenure alone does not satisfy this requirement.

• Demonstrated delivery of real estate projects with responsibility for programme, contractors, teams, cost, quality and completion; credible evidence of completed project handovers.

• Strong practical command of MEP coordination, interiors and finishing execution, including interfaces between civil, architectural and building-services works.

• Proven ability to direct junior engineers and supervisors and manage contractors and labour teams operating in Western Uttar Pradesh.

Key responsibilities

Project planning and execution leadership

• Own mobilisation, project schedules, critical paths, milestone plans and weekly work fronts; align design releases, procurement, manpower, equipment and site readiness.

• Lead execution of structural works, township infrastructure and external development against approved drawings, specifications and construction methods.

• Track daily progress and productivity across assigned sites; identify slippages early and implement quantified recovery plans with named owners and dates.

• Coordinate architects, structural consultants, MEP consultants, vendors and management; maintain drawing and revision control, close RFIs and prevent execution on superseded drawings.

MEP integration and commissioning

• Direct coordination of electrical, plumbing, drainage, HVAC, firefighting and other applicable building services through specialist engineers and contractors.

• Review coordinated service layouts, shafts, sleeves, openings, levels, equipment access and installation sequences before civil closure; resolve clashes and avoid rework.

• Monitor MEP procurement and installation milestones, inspections, testing and commissioning; verify records, system readiness and closure of defects with the relevant specialists.

Interiors and finishing delivery

• Control execution and interfaces for masonry, plaster, waterproofing, flooring, tiling, ceilings, joinery, painting, glazing and facade works, as applicable.

• Approve work fronts and monitor mock-ups, samples, material approvals, tolerances and finish standards through the agreed approval process.

• Sequence interiors with MEP installations and testing; protect completed works, prevent damage and ensure finishing quality meets approved specifications.

Team and Western UP contractor management

• Lead Site Engineers, Senior Engineers, supervisors and junior staff; define responsibilities, daily targets and inspection duties, and review performance and technical capability.

• Manage Western UP contractors and subcontractors through clear scope, output targets, manpower commitments, measurements and documented performance reviews.

• Resolve site coordination problems, contractor disputes and labour-productivity issues promptly; arrange corrective action or recommend replacement where performance fails.

• Maintain disciplined site communication in Hindi and clear written reporting; enforce accountability without allowing unresolved issues to depend on continuous management intervention.

. daily reporting and strict accountability for zero material wastage/pilferage on site are non-negotiable.

**Cost quality safety and project controls**

• Monitor approved budgets, quantities, commitments and cost-to-complete; flag overruns and evaluate corrective options before additional expenditure is committed.

• Scrutinise BOQs, measurements, running bills, variations and final accounts; ensure traceable quantities and obtain approvals within delegated authority.

• Plan material requirements and procurement lead times; control stock, reconciliation, wastage and utilisation of steel, cement, RMC and other major materials.

• Enforce inspection and test plans, survey and alignment controls, material tests, workmanship checks, waterproofing tests and closure of non-conformities.

• Enforce site safety procedures, contractor safety discipline and applicable project requirements; coordinate permissions and inspections with authorised specialists.

• Maintain DPRs, weekly progress reviews and monthly management dashboards covering milestones, cost, quality, safety, manpower, risks and decisions required.

Completion and project handover

• Plan phased completion and handover from the execution stage; prepare readiness checklists and coordinate joint inspections with management, consultants and relevant recipients.

• Own snagging and de-snagging, testing and commissioning closure, as-built drawings, warranties, O&M manuals and contractor completion documentation.

• Coordinate documents and works required for applicable completion or occupancy approvals with the responsible consultants and authorities.

• Complete handover to the designated client, customer or facility team; record acceptance, outstanding obligations and defect-liability responsibilities.

Performance expectations

Delivery against approved milestones and budgets; reliable progress forecasts; timely closure of civil-MEP-interior interfaces; reduced rework and material wastage; contractor productivity; junior-team accountability; safe execution; and documented handovers with controlled outstanding snags. Project-specific targets will be agreed at mobilisation.

Work arrangements and application

Site-based role with inter-site travel and flexibility during critical activities. Working hours, weekly rest and leave will be confirmed in the employment terms. Travel, relocation or accommodation support may be discussed for suitable outstation candidates.

Send your CV, degree details, leadership-role chronology, project sizes and types, team sizes, Western UP contractor experience, completed handovers, current/expected compensation and notice period to 
**recruiter@alteora.in**
. Contact: 
**+91-7007043608**
.

title: Senior Site Engineer - Commercial
company: Alteora : Business Consulting | HR Consulting | IT Recruitments
description:
**Senior Site Engineer : Commercial & High Rise Construction**

**Location:**
Assigned sites across Meerut and the Meerut region, Uttar Pradesh

**Employment:**
Full-time and on-site; inter-site travel as assigned

**Experience:**
Minimum 5 years to 15 years of relevant hands-on site execution, with proven work-front, contractor and junior-team leadership

**Qualification:**
B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Civil Engineering

**Reporting:**
GM/Project Manager or designated project lead

**Joining:**
Immediate preferred; maximum notice period 15-20 days

**Compensation:**
To be finalised by management for the respective grade, based on relevant experience and capability

**Role purpose**

Lead assigned commercial-building work fronts and supervise junior engineers, contractors and labour teams. Ensure accurate civil execution, strong MEP coordination, disciplined labour deployment and completion of assigned structural and finishing works to approved drawings, quality standards and schedules. Maintain complete daily reporting and strict accountability for preventing material wastage and pilferage.

**Mandatory technical requirements**

• Relevant experience in multistorey commercial or high-rise building construction; independently read architectural, structural and coordinated service GFC drawings.

• Strong RCC execution knowledge covering excavation, foundations, reinforcement, BBS, formwork, staging, concreting, curing and dimensional checks.

• Practical MEP coordination capability: electrical, plumbing, drainage, HVAC and firefighting interfaces, including sleeves, openings, shafts, embedded items and service clearances.

• Proven on-site labour handling: allocate work, check attendance and trade-wise deployment, monitor output, enforce discipline and resolve execution constraints.

• Working knowledge of finishing sequences, waterproofing, masonry and civil-MEP interfaces; competent in auto-level use, setting-out checks, Excel and AutoCAD.

• Demonstrated independent work-front planning, contractor coordination, technical problem-solving, quantity verification and supervision of junior engineers; support experience with project examples and references.

**Senior Site Engineer responsibilities**

• Supervise reinforcement, shuttering, cover, laps, anchorage, alignment and pre-pour inspections; record clearances before concrete placement.

• Control concrete receipt, placement, vibration, sampling, curing and construction joints; coordinate slump/cube tests and maintain traceable quality records.

• Resolve civil-MEP interfaces before pours, wall closure and finishes; obtain approved clarification for clashes and prohibit unauthorised cutting of structural members.

• Sequence civil, MEP, waterproofing and finishing trades; protect completed works and close snags within assigned deadlines.

• Deploy labour by activity and trade; verify daily attendance and output, monitor subcontractor commitments and escalate shortages or persistent underperformance.

• Own weekly look-ahead plans and daily targets; coordinate drawings, materials, labour and equipment, allocate work to juniors and contractors, and drive recovery of delays.

• Verify junior engineers' measurements, quality checks and material reconciliations; review contractor bills and variations against approved scope before recommending certification.

**Daily reporting and material accountability**

• Daily reporting is mandatory. Submit a signed DPR by the site-prescribed cut-off every working day, recording planned versus achieved quantities, labour and equipment deployment, inspections/tests, safety issues, constraints and the next day's plan.

• Maintain daily opening stock, receipts, authorised issues, actual consumption, returns, recoverable scrap and closing stock for materials under assigned control. Reconcile against executed quantities and approved consumption norms; explain every variance.

• Enforce a zero material wastage and zero pilferage requirement. Prevent over-issue, misuse, unauthorised removal, damage and avoidable loss through controlled storage, documented issues/returns and gate-pass checks with stores/security.

• Record any unavoidable process loss or approved allowance transparently; never conceal losses, manipulate consumption records or adjust stock without authorisation. Report suspected theft, shortages or unexplained variances immediately and support investigation and corrective action.

**Quality safety and selection standards**

Maintain approved drawing revisions, inspection records, test results, measurements and photographic evidence. Stop non-conforming or unsafe work and escalate promptly. Performance will be assessed on schedule delivery, quality, labour/equipment productivity, complete daily reports and traceable material control. No unexplained material variance or unreported loss is acceptable.

Screen out candidates below the stated experience minimum, without relevant field execution, unable to demonstrate the mandatory technical skills, unwilling to work on-site, or unwilling to accept daily reporting and material accountability. Assessment includes drawing interpretation, quantities/material reconciliation and labour planning, plus a civil-MEP coordination and pre-pour case.

**Application and work arrangements**

Apply to recruiter@alteora.in or call +91-7007043608. Share CV, preferred profile/grade, relevant projects and responsibilities, current location, current/expected compensation and notice period. Site hours, weekly rest, leave and any relocation/accommodation support will be confirmed in employment terms.

title: Senior Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
RS INFRA PROJECTS PVT LTD is an infrastructure-focused organization delivering engineering and construction solutions across a range of industrial and commercial projects. The company is committed to quality, safety, and timely project delivery, working closely with clients and partners to meet technical and regulatory requirements. Team members collaborate in a fast-paced environment that values practical problem-solving, clear communication, and professional integrity. The organization offers opportunities to work on complex projects, contribute to visible outcomes, and grow through hands-on experience and responsibility.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time Senior Engineer role based in Dadri, offered in a hybrid format that allows some work-from-home flexibility. The Senior Engineer will oversee planning, design, and execution of infrastructure projects, ensuring compliance with technical standards, safety regulations, and client specifications. Day-to-day responsibilities include reviewing engineering drawings, coordinating with site teams and contractors, monitoring project progress, and resolving technical issues that arise during construction. The role will involve preparing reports and documentation, optimizing resources and schedules, and supporting cost control and quality assurance activities. The Senior Engineer will collaborate with cross-functional teams, provide technical guidance to junior staff, and help drive continuous improvement in project delivery.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong applied engineering skills, with the ability to interpret and develop technical drawings, specifications, and calculations.
* Candidates should possess project coordination and management skills, including planning, scheduling, and overseeing site activities to meet timelines and quality standards.
* Candidates should possess problem-solving and analytical skills, with experience identifying risks, proposing practical solutions, and making data-informed decisions.
* Candidates should possess communication and collaboration skills, including clear reporting, stakeholder management, and effective teamwork with multidisciplinary groups.
* Candidates should possess familiarity with relevant safety regulations, construction codes, and industry best practices in infrastructure projects.
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Mechanical, or related Engineering discipline; advanced qualifications or professional certifications are an advantage.
* Several years of experience in infrastructure or construction projects in a senior or lead engineering capacity.
* Comfort working in a hybrid environment, with readiness to be present on-site in Dadri as project needs require.

title: Principal Consultant-Ecology
description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.
   

  

 We are more than 36,000 people, in over 70 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.
   

  

**Role description:**
 Join our dynamic, internationally focused ecology team delivering high\-impact solutions for UK projects. As a Principal Consultant – Ecology, you will lead technical delivery, team growth, and innovation in ecological services, leveraging advanced digital tools and global best practices.
   

  

**Role accountabilities:**
* Technical Leadership \& Reporting
+ Lead and author high\-quality ecological reports, including scoping and baseline sections of Environmental Impact Assessments (EIAs), Biodiversity Net Gain (BNG) reports, and related technical documents.
+ Oversee the quality assurance and technical accuracy of project deliverables, ensuring compliance with UK and European standards.

* Team Management \& Mentoring
+ Manage and mentor a team of 8\-10 ecology professionals, fostering a collaborative, high\-performance culture and supporting individual career development.
+ Take responsibility for securing work, including identifying new opportunities, building relationship and contributing to business growth.
+ Contribute to team growth, succession planning, and skills development in line with the latest industry trends.

* Field Expertise \& Innovation
+ Design, supervise, and review ecological and species surveys, and habitat assessments relevant to UK and European contexts.
+ Apply advanced identification skills for a range of taxa/species associated with key habitats, leveraging international experience and transferable knowledge (e.g., bat species across geographies).

* Legislation \& Policy Application
+ Demonstrate expert knowledge and application of UK and European environmental legislation, policy, and best practice guidance.


* Digital \& Analytical Excellence
+ Utilise advanced digital tools (e.g., GIS, R, Bat Explorer, AI\-powered ecology platforms) for field data collection, analysis, and reporting.
+ Champion digital transformation and innovation within the ecology team.
+ Identify and support build areas of standardisation and automation
+ Able to manage internal and external Quality Audit.

* Safety \& Biosecurity
+ Take full responsibility for adherence to biosecurity and health and safety protocols across all project phases.

* Stakeholder Engagement
+ Act as a key point of contact for clients, regulators, and partners, demonstrating outstanding communication and influencing skills.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**
* Education: Master’s degree (minimum) in Zoology, Ecology, Conservation Biology, or a related environmental discipline. Candidates with a PhD and strong industry experience will be highly preferred.
* Professional Membership: Membership of a relevant professional body (e.g., CIEEM, IES) – or international equivalent – is desirable.
* Experience:
+ 15–20 years of relevant professional experience in ecological consultancy, conservation, or related sectors.
+ Proven track record of delivering UK\-based ecology projects from India or similar international contexts.
+ Demonstrated experience in managing and developing high\-performing teams.

* Technical Skills:
+ Advanced knowledge and operational proficiency in ArcGIS, bat analysis software, and digital data management tools.
+ Proven report writing and review capabilities for large consultancy and donor agencies.
+ Hands\-on experience with AI applications in ecology is a strong advantage.

* Other Skills:
+ Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to present complex information to technical and non\-technical audiences.
+ Proficiency in foreign languages (especially relevant to UK/European contexts) is an added advantage.

* Desirable Attributes
+ Experience with global or cross\-continental ecological projects.
+ Passion for innovation, digital transformation, and sustainability.
+ Strong network within the ecology and environmental consultancy community.


 Why Arcadis?
   

  

 We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills\-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.
